whether it may replace the current one.

::: {.callout-decision}
## Decide Whether the System May Change

Decide whether the interaction data may be used, then decide whether the
resulting candidate may replace the current system.

Record the trajectory schema, governed dataset lineage, coverage report,
change-control process, candidate record, and rollback path.
:::

::: {.callout-lab}
## Reject Data the System Should Not Learn From

Detect missing lineage, biased coverage, ambiguous action semantics, or invalid
consent. Decide whether the experience and any resulting update may proceed.
:::
